定语从句(一):who / which / that: 像贴在名词后面的"补充标签",把两个句子缝成一句,让表达立刻紧凑。
who 指人,which 指物,that 人物皆可|关系代词在从句中作宾语时可省略|where 指地点,when 指时间|whose 表所属:the boy whose father...|逗号后(非限定)不能用 that
The woman who lives next door is a nurse.
column3: 住在隔壁的那位女士是护士。

定语从句(一):who / which / that: This is the app which I use every day.
The film that we watched was moving.
This is the school where my mother teaches.
column3: 这就是我妈妈教书的学校。

定语从句(一):who / which / that: He is the student whose project won first prize.
column3: 他就是项目得一等奖的那个学生。

# title: The man ___ helped me was tall and thin.
column4: 先行词是人且在从句中作主语,用 who。

# title: I lost the pen ___ you gave me.
column4: 先行词是物,作宾语可用 that(也可省略)。

# title: That is the cafe ___ we first met.
column4: 先行词是地点,从句缺地点状语,用 where。

# title: Do you remember the day ___ we moved in?
She has a friend ___ brother works in a bank.
column4: 表所属"朋友的哥哥",用 whose。

# title: The book ___ cover is red is mine.
column4: 书的封面,表所属用 whose。
